item.title: A second look to Multer DOS
item.description:
For context check an old post

To keep things short, I’ve been doing some software archeology on my pasts projects. I noticed that my opensourced project https://github.com/Daniel-M/multer-dos was getting about 10 downloads a week on the npm registry https://www.npmjs.com/package/multer-dos so i decided to add support for typescript and dependency updates. The project is so easy to maintain, I guess part of the 10 downloads per week means this is still used in production by some people, so thanks for believing in me

item.title: ExpressJS uploads to Digital Ocean Spaces through S3 AWS-S3
item.description:
This is a short story. I was trying to use multer-s3 to perform uploads to Digital-Ocean-Spaces (DOS) using the AWS S3 protocol. It ended up failing to make things work with the things available and ended up implementing my own plugin to perform multipart uploads as an expressjs middleware. You can check the code here,

  • https://github.com/Daniel-M/multer-dos
  • https://www.npmjs.com/package/multer-dos
